entry.vector: 0 px/s of camera travel — there is no in-phone camera in this film. .screen-world holds scale 1 / x 0 / y 0 for the whole scene and the device never transforms. The scene opens mid-action instead: the missed-savings analysis arc is already spinning at t=0 (690deg over 0-1.5s, ease:none) over a fully populated המלצות screen, so the cut from frame 18 lands on continuing content, not on a continuing move.

exit.vector: 0 px/s — the layout is static from 11.24s. The last type call-out settles at 11.24s and nothing enters, exits or moves for the final 0.76s; the completed five-row feed is what the cut to frame 20 hands over. Frame 20 opens on the same still, un-zoomed screen geometry, so the seam is a content cut, not a velocity match.

notes.first_second: device + already-populated המלצות · חיסכון שפוספס screen present at t=0, camera-free; the analysis spinner is running (diegetic working state) and resolves into the success check at 1.46-1.94s. Stage kicker 0.3s, title 0.45s. Nothing scales the device.
notes.last_second: held. From 11.24s the notifications feed stands complete and completely still — five rows, three of them unread, all badges at rest.
notes.toast_overlay: 1.8-4.1s the .toast rides OVER the live screen (y -260 -> 0, back.out(1.2)) while the recommendations page stays fully visible underneath — that overlay is the entire argument for 'בזמן אמת, בלי לרענן'. The header bell rings once on arrival (1.95-2.39s) and the app's own dismiss meter runs 1.8-4.1s. The 20% retime shortened the silence around this beat, not the read itself.
notes.staged_reveals: reactive-displacement swap 4.1-5.2s (feed in from above, previous page displaced down, toast consumed), page head 5.3s / sub 5.48s, then — the fix for the near-empty render — the feed arrives as a FULL list: all five rows cascade 5.85-6.95s (stagger 0.16s) with their type badges popping 0.08s behind each row. From 6.95s the screen is a real, populated app screen. The four notification types are then called out one per narration beat at 7.6 / 8.6 / 9.6 / 10.6s (ניתוח · מועדונים, two rows · דיל · מערכת) as a badge + row scale accent, ending 11.24s.
notes.feed_content: the real notifications endpoint payload: badges from notifications.badge.* (ניתוח / מועדונים / דיל / מערכת), titles from notifications.title.* (הניתוח מוכן / התאמת מועדון חדשה / התאמת דיל חדשה / עדכון מערכת), message lines from notifications.detail.*, relative times from common.justNow / hoursAgo / daysAgo. Exactly three rows carry the unread ring + dot, matching the '3 שלא נקראו' count. Store name FOX - פוקס is the real demo-data store, isolated LTR so the bidi algorithm cannot reverse it.
notes.camera_target: none. Any data-camera-target attribute has been removed from this scene; nothing zooms.
